findings.title: Orchestrator submit has no atomicity — duplicate runs on partial failure
findings.description: If status-update API call fails after orchestrator run is dispatched, user sees generic error and may re-submit, spawning duplicate orchestrator runs.
findings.recommendation: Separate error handling: after submitWork succeeds, status update failures should show a warning, not a generic failure message.

findings.title: Zero authentication on all API endpoints
findings.description: No auth middleware, no JWT, no sessions, no user concept. Every endpoint is open to anonymous callers.
findings.recommendation: Implement auth middleware with JWT or session-based authentication.

findings.title: Unauthenticated admin operations (approve/deny)
findings.description: Approve/deny routes have no access control.
findings.recommendation: Require admin role for approve/deny endpoints.

findings.title: Unauthenticated pipeline stage manipulation
findings.description: Pipeline manipulation routes have no access control.

findings.title: MIME type check bypassable on upload
findings.description: MIME type validation can be bypassed by crafted Content-Type headers.
findings.recommendation: Validate file magic bytes server-side, not just Content-Type.

findings.title: Unauthenticated image upload/delete
findings.description: Image upload and delete endpoints have no authentication.

findings.title: Path traversal via img.filename in orchestrator fetch
findings.description: img.filename from DB is used in fetch URL without validation. Poisoned DB records could cause path traversal.
findings.recommendation: Validate img.filename matches /^[a-f0-9-]+\.[a-z]+$/ before constructing fetch URL.

findings.title: Malicious original_name forwarded to orchestrator as File name
findings.description: img.original_name from DB used as File constructor name parameter without sanitization, forwarded to orchestrator.
findings.recommendation: Sanitize original_name to [a-zA-Z0-9._-], strip path separators, enforce max 255 chars.

findings.title: repo field unvalidated in FR orchestrator submit
findings.description: selectedRepo flows unvalidated to orchestrator. If orchestrator uses it in git clone, command injection possible.
findings.recommendation: Validate repo against owner/repo format or URL allowlist both client-side and server-side.

findings.title: repo field unvalidated in bug orchestrator submit
findings.description: Same injection vector as SEC-032 but for bug workflow.

findings.title: FR test does not assert repo field in orchestrator submit
findings.description: Test uses expect.objectContaining({ images }) which passes whether repo is present or not.
findings.recommendation: Extend assertion to include repo field.

findings.title: BugDetail orchestrator submit path has zero test coverage
findings.description: No test verifies Submit to Orchestrator button, orchestrator.submitWork call, bugs.update call, or onUpdate callback for bugs.
findings.recommendation: Add test exercising BugDetail orchestrator submit flow with assertions on all call arguments.

findings.title: Image re-hydration 404 not checked — 0-byte files sent silently
findings.description: fetch() for images does not check res.ok. HTTP 404 produces 0-byte File objects silently forwarded to orchestrator.
findings.recommendation: Add if (!res.ok) throw new Error() after each fetch call.

findings.title: onUpdate inside try block — callback throw masquerades as submit failure
findings.description: onUpdate() called inside try block. If callback throws, user sees 'Failed to submit' despite successful submission.
findings.recommendation: Move onUpdate() outside the try/catch or wrap in separate try/catch.

findings.title: Custom repo input never committed to selectedRepo
findings.description: Custom repo text input bound to customRepo state but never written to selectedRepo. Submit always uses the previously-selected dropdown value.
findings.recommendation: Wire customRepo to setSelectedRepo with format validation.

findings.title: Picomatch ReDoS (HIGH) — dev-toolchain only
findings.description: GHSA-c2c7-rcm5-vvqj: ReDoS in picomatch <=2.3.1 / 4.0.0-4.0.3. Dev-only dependency. Not introduced by this fix.
findings.recommendation: Run npm audit fix to update picomatch.
